description: Cedric, the AI employee for team chat, as a remote MCP server and HTTP API: connect any MCP client, call his tools, run chat turns, upload files.
rules: Connect to https://app.meet-cedric.com/api/v1/mcp over Streamable HTTP; sign in with OAuth or send Authorization: Bearer cedric_sk_...
Call the getting_started tool first after connecting.

Under a sign-in or standard key, gmail_send, send_dm, the calendar write tools, integration_request, integration_bulk, integration_upload, run_recipe, run_code and schedule_automation return requires_direct_key; use a direct key or delegate through ask_cedric.

Work delegated through ask_cedric or /api/v1/chat on a sign-in or standard key never sends on its own: each send waits on a card in the key owner's Action Centre. Tell the user, and do not resend the request.
send_channel_message, move_event_hook and start_build return pending_approval under a standard key; poll proposal_status until a person decides.
The chat endpoint /api/v1/chat takes an API key, not a sign-in token.
